title: lint: the liveness-properties worked example still names `manifest.runtime`, which is now a `live` row (#27123 follow-up)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

carries owed item 4 of #27123's slice-3 handover (Release `6496079064`); #27123 keeps card items 4 and 6 and owed item 5 (i18n-extract).

## What is wrong

`packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.ts` uses `manifest.runtime` as its worked example of a `live-elsewhere` row in two places: the doc comment (`* \`manifest.runtime\`, whose enforcer is the cloud marketplace publish gate`) and the `live-elsewhere` `defaultHint` string (`"(for \`manifest.runtime\`, the cloud marketplace publish gate); see the ledger row's "`). Since #27374 (slice 2 of #27123) that ledger row (`packages/spec/liveness/manifest.json`, `runtime`) reads `live` on local evidence, so the example now teaches a reader the opposite of the ledger.

Re-check: `grep -n "manifest.runtime" packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.ts` (2 hits on `main` @ `72b08eec`) and the `runtime` row's `status` in `packages/spec/liveness/manifest.json`.

## Expected

Both places use a neutral example (a row that is `live-elsewhere` today, or a generic description). No behaviour change. `packages/lint/CHANGELOG.md` is release-owned: do not edit it.

Source: contract review `6493264083` should-fix 7, carried by the Release comment on #27123. Filed without `domain:*`: the lane is triage's call (`packages/lint`).
